tools.name: search_catalog
tools.description: Search the apteka.online catalog by product name, brand, active ingredient or need. Returns products in store ranking order, available ones first on each page of 60, with price and availability; a product page is /products/{handle}. apteka.online is a Polish online pharmacy: it sells only non-prescr

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Get one apteka.online product by handle (from search_catalog results or a /products/{handle} URL): current price, availability, max quantity, variants with ids for the cart and a short description. details_url has the full data: composition, dosage, warnings. apteka.online is a Polish online pharmac

tools.name: search_shop_policies_and_faqs
tools.description: Look up apteka.online shop policies: delivery methods and costs, payment methods, returns and complaints, discounts. Ask in Polish, e.g. dostawa, płatności, zwroty, reklamacje. Returns the best section, the other titles and links to the terms and privacy policy. apteka.online is a Polish online phar

tools.name: build_cart_link
tools.description: Build a link that puts products in the visitor's apteka.online cart (variant_id from search_catalog or get_product). The visitor opens it, checks the list and adds it; nothing changes before that, and the visitor pays at checkout. apteka.online is a Polish online pharmacy: it sells only non-prescrip

tools.name: search_medicines
tools.description: Search the register of medicines authorised in Poland by brand name or active substance, prescription and non-prescription, like the /lek catalog on apteka.online. Returns slug, substance, strength, form, prescription (rx or otc), refunded and sold_online; use get_medicine, get_medicine_document or

tools.name: get_medicine
tools.description: Get one medicine from the register by slug (from search_medicines or a /lek/{slug} URL): substance, strength, form, dispensing category, marketing authorisation holder, ATC code, packs with EAN, whether it is refunded, and the sections of its patient leaflet (ulotka) and SmPC (chpl) for get_medicine

tools.name: get_medicine_document
tools.description: Read the patient leaflet (ulotka) or the Summary of Product Characteristics (chpl) of a medicine from the register, one section at a time, e.g. chpl 4.2 for dosing, ulotka 3 for how to take it. Without section it lists the sections. A long section comes in parts: ask for part 2 and on while part < p

tools.name: get_refund_prices
tools.description: Official refund prices of a medicine from the current Ministry of Health announcement, per pack (EAN): price at 100%, and per refunded indication the payment level and the patient's copay, plus free_65_plus and free_under_18. The same figures as the /lek card, with the validity of the announcement.

tools.name: find_equivalents
tools.description: Find medicines with the same active substance, like /odpowiedniki on apteka.online: sold_online lists shop products with price and unit price, catalog lists the register's other brands with official refund prices, availability in pharmacies and parallel imports. Filter by dose, route, salt, excipien

tools.name: compare_medicines
tools.description: Compare two non-prescription medicines with the same active substance, like the "X czy Y" pages on apteka.online: indications from each SmPC (section 4.1), forms and strengths they share or not, and their offers in the shop. Only curated pairs: polocard czy acard, altaziaja czy altacet, zoxin-med cz

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_product, get_medicine · Private data: get_medicine_document · Public sink: compare_medicines.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_product, get_medicine · Private data: get_medicine_document · Public sink: compare_medicines

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
